Document: # Rule 1.1 Do not attempt to evade bans, ahelp questioning, or punishments. Do not abuse the ahelp system. - Ban evasion will result in an immediate voucher ban. - Attempting to circumvent a role ban via requesting/accepting a promotion to the banned role in-game is considered ban evasion and will likely result in a game ban. - Evading an ahelp via disconnecting upon being messaged, disconnecting during questioning within the ahelp, or ignoring the messaging admin will usually end in an appeal ban. - Do not disconnect during questioning if you were involved in the issue prompting the ahelp without permission from the questioning admin. If an admin does not respond for 10 minutes or more during ahelp questioning, you may assume the admin is done questioning you (given that you have contacted them one or more times to ask if you are free to go). - Spamming ahelps or disrespecting staff will result in an appeal ban.
